description: Widanagamage Ajith Kumara v. Hon. Attorney General Widanagamage Ajith Kumara v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. P.R. Walgama, J
parties: Widanagamage Ajith Kumara v. Hon. Attorney General Widanagamage Ajith Kumara v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: Revision – Confiscation of motor vehicle – Vehicle used in drug offence – Cannabis Sativa – Guilty plea – Automatic statutory forfeiture – Third-party owner – Whether separate confiscation inquiry required – Distinction from Forest Ordinance confiscation – No statutory right of third-party owner to prevent forfeiture – No right of appeal – Revision cannot be used to obtain relief unavailable under statute – Application dismissed with Rs.10,000 costs. L.T.B. Dehideniya J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Article 138; Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance – section 79; Forest Ordinance – section 40; Forest (Amendment) Act No. 65 of 2009.
